branch: local built-in output: bare whole-message assistant frame renders; streamed messages never double-render
provenance: Measured 2026-08-15 (CLI 2.1.233, the panel's exact spawn flags, testing repo): '/context' produces system/init -> ONE whole-message assistant frame -> result, with ZERO stream_events — the only live shape that must render from a whole message rather than deltas. The transcript spells the SAME content differently again: system/local_command with <local-command-stdout>…</local-command-stdout> (session 41a89e81…), covered by SessionStoreTest, not this fixture. Found by the user running /context the day info-style built-ins were enabled: 'Puttered for 1s' and nothing rendered. NEGATIVE CONTROL RUN 2026-08-15 against the pre-fix build: the 3 assertions marked DISCRIMINATING failed, both guards green. STEPS 4-7 ADDED 2026-08-15 after the command sweep: /security-review failed deterministically in ~/Sites/claude-brains-testing (no origin/HEAD) and the panel rendered a completion line with ZERO blocks. The tape showed the CLI did send the error — a `user` frame whose message.content is a STRING carrying <local-command-stderr>…</local-command-stderr> (captured verbatim from session eb8a3598…, frame text reproduced below) — which onUserEvent dropped at its `if (!Array.isArray(content)) return;` guard before any rendering logic. NEGATIVE CONTROL RUN 2026-08-15 against the pre-fix build (the live sandbox still carried it): 4 assertions failed — both stderr DISCRIMINATING and both stdout ones — and all 5 GUARDs passed, incl. the caveat-still-invisible and array-path-untouched pair. STEP 8 ADDED 2026-08-15: the CLI emits an `assistant` frame PER CONTENT BLOCK, not per message (taped live: message_start -> content_block_start -> assistant -> content_block_stop, repeating). A message with a thinking block therefore sends TWO assistant frames, and the first one consumed the msgStreamed flag, so the second re-rendered text the deltas had already drawn — every message after the first appeared twice in a /security-review run (both copies stamped with the same uuid, because stampMessage stamps all pending blocks). The flag is therefore a TURN-level fact: set at message_start, cleared only at result/sendTurn/clearLogUI — never mid-turn. A message_stop reset was tried and rejected the same hour: assistant frames straddle message_stop in both directions, so step 2 (frame after the stop) started double-rendering instead.
